mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shelter (shelter_id, shelter_name, lat, lng, address, admin_id, shelter_cap, shelter_cur, money_cur, money_req, status, contact) VALUES (#{shelterId}, #{shelterName}, #{lat}, #{lng}, #{address}, #{adminId}, #{shelterCap}, #{shelterCur}, #{moneyCur}, #{moneyReq}, #{status}, #{contact});
mapper.update: UPDATE shelter SET shelter_name = #{shelterName}, lat = #{lat}, lng = #{lng}, address = #{address}, admin_id = #{adminId}, shelter_cap = #{shelterCap}, shelter_cur = #{shelterCur}, money_cur = #{moneyCur}, money_req = #{moneyReq}, status = #{status}, contact = #{contact} WHERE shelter_id = #{shelterId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shelter WHERE status = #{status}
